fieldValues.title: A claimed author cannot be checked
fieldValues.statement: A group sharing a memory cannot tell whether a record came from who it says. The author is whatever the writer's session declares, a later edit leaves no trace of the editor in the record, and nothing compares either with a key. So a member's word and a forged one look the same, and attribution can never become more than a claim.
source_ref: srs-programme: research finding '2. Two writers on one memory: the test' (2026-11-06)
strategy contract e06081bf (attribution mechanism: promoted only by a verification mechanism such as a signature)
